sections.title: Put the journey together
sections.content: You know all of these: the present tense, *tener que*, *tener*, *querer*, *necesitar* and *ir a* + infinitive. Combine them with the travel words of this unit to describe the start of a journey.

sections.title: Starting a journey
rows: Tengo que ir a la estación.
I have to go to the station.
I am going to take the train.
We are going to travel today.

items.spanish: Tengo que ir a la estación.
items.english: I have to go to the station.
I am going to take the train.

sections.content: A travel conversation can combine several familiar structures: *Tengo que...*, *Necesito...*, *Quiero...*, *Voy a...*
